model: RandomForestClassifier (500 trees, random_state=42) with zeros-as-missing median imputation
notes: Dropped 57 exact duplicate rows before an 80/20 stratified split (seed 42). Physiologically impossible zeros in glucose, blood_pressure, skin_thickness, insulin, bmi were treated as missing and median-imputed; 5-fold CV on train was 0.82, so the single test split (0.91) is likely optimistic.
